intake.business_request_raw: Analyze the Sweet Bank Kotlin banking application for modernization. Utilize the Kotlin skill pack for deep analysis of Kotlin-specific patterns.
assumptions: The current application is fully functional and stable.
All necessary documentation for the existing system is available.

input_contract.business_objective: Analyze the Sweet Bank Kotlin banking application for modernization. Utilize the Kotlin skill pack for deep analysis of Kotlin-specific patterns.

relationships: LegacyInput contract must map deterministically to ModernizedOutput contract

standards_guidance.name: ISO 20022 Core Messages
engineering_actions: Validate payment payload structure against canonical message schema.
Use deterministic field mapping and explicit validation errors.
Retain original inbound/outbound message payloads for audit evidence.

standards_guidance.name: FIX Protocol Baseline
engineering_actions: Enforce message sequencing and replay protection.
Capture deterministic routing/acknowledgement states in logs.

gold_patterns.title: Idempotent Payments Endpoint
guidance: Require Idempotency-Key header for payment creation.
Persist key + payload hash + response tuple with TTL.
Return 409 for same key with divergent payload.

gold_patterns.title: Audit Evidence Spine
guidance: Attach stable requirement IDs to audit events and tests.
Emit correlation_id, trace_id, actor_id on all state changes.
Persist tamper-evident release evidence pack manifests.

gold_patterns.title: PII Redaction and Access Policy
guidance: Centralize redaction middleware for logs and errors.
Define allowlist fields for support and analytics views.
Block production debug endpoints exposing raw payloads.

non_negotiables: Audit logging is required for privileged and financial state changes.
Idempotency is required for externally retriable financial write operations.
PII and regulated payment fields must be masked in logs.
Ledger-impacting operations must define consistency and reversal behavior.

must.title: Security Compliance
must.description: Ensure all modules comply with security standards and regulations.
acceptance_criteria: Security audits confirm compliance with standards.
No critical vulnerabilities found in penetration tests.
Security patches are applied within 48 hours of release.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: Ensure the system has 99.9% uptime and is resilient to failures.
acceptance_criteria: System monitoring shows 99.9% uptime over a month.
Automatic failover is tested and verified.
Disaster recovery procedures are documented and tested.

should.title: System Performance
should.description: The system should handle 10,000 transactions per minute with less than 1% error rate.
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests confirm the system can handle the load.
Error rate remains below 1% during peak load.
System response time is under 200ms for 95% of transactions.

should.title: Scalability
should.description: The application should scale horizontally to support increased load.
acceptance_criteria: System can scale to double the initial load without performance degradation.
Load tests confirm scalability requirements are met.

should.title: Usability
should.description: The application should have an intuitive user interface that enhances user experience.
acceptance_criteria: User testing results in a satisfaction score of 4.5 or higher.
UI components are accessible and follow design guidelines.
Feedback from usability tests is incorporated into the design.
